files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.AI.Animatronics.AnimatronicBase
files.Summary: Base abstract class for all animatronics in the framework. Manages the asynchronous AI tick loops, components injection, modular strategy handlers, movement, and event subscriptions.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.AI.Animatronics.AnimatronicCondition
files.Summary: Abstract base class for custom AI movement blockers (e.g., stopping when observed by cameras).

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.AI.Animatronics.AnimatronicNode
files.Summary: Defines a single spatial anchor junction points layout representation within the path matrix graph mesh hierarchy. Handles pose clip asset bindings and processes localized entry or exit callback triggers.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.AI.Animatronics.PathConnection
files.Summary: Serializable compound structural block defining an outbound path connection routing option, its statistical weight ratio parameter, and condition layout validation dependencies.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.AI.Animatronics.PathValidationArgs
files.Summary: Data container class that encapsulates state results during the path validation processing pass. Used to signal whether a custom rule evaluation has blocked an outbound node connection.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Components.DefaultAnimationHandler
files.Summary: Component managing animatronic animations using low-overhead PlayableGraphs. Handles instant node pose baking and full-speed jumpscare animations.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Components.InstantMovementHandler
files.Summary: Movement strategy component that handles instant teleportation of an animatronic between nodes.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Components.StandardAILogic
files.Summary: Custom path-finding AI logic handler strategy. Implements weighted node evaluation, dynamic distance-to-office difficulty scaling, and automated fallback logic.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Debugging.PizzeriaLogCollector
files.Summary: Lightweight background log collector that captures Unity logs in all builds. Survives scene loads and automatically dumps logs on crash.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Enums.CloseTransitionType
files.Summary: Supported visual transition animation types when a menu page exits the viewport.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Enums.OpenTransitionType
files.Summary: Supported visual transition animation types when a menu page enters the viewport.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Enums.PopupTypeEnum
files.Summary: Defines the visual category of a popup notification.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Enums.TimeDisplayFormatEnum
files.Summary: Supported formatting modes used to calculate and render the active time state string layout.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.GameLoop.SecurityCamera
files.Summary: Controls individual security camera parameters, tracking states, and toggles execution priority levels across Cinemachine virtual camera rigs dynamically. Includes an automated linear transform-based panning routine.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IAILogic
files.Summary: Strategy interface for implementing custom AI behavior, tick intervals, and logical conditions for animatronics within the framework.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IAnimationHandler
files.Summary: Strategy interface for implementing custom animation systems, static node pose baking, and jumpscare rendering mechanisms.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IAnimatronic
files.Summary: The core interface contract exposed to managers and strategy handlers. Provides decoupled access to identity data, level settings, positioning nodes, and direct interactions.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IDraggable
files.Summary: Interface contract for implementing drag-and-drop mechanics or interactive object manipulation within the framework. Commonly utilized for editor tooling handles, grid layouts, or puzzle-based inventory mechanics.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IInteractable
files.Summary: Core interface contract for implementing interactive object behaviors within the framework. Commonly used for doors, lights, monitors, fuses, or items the player can activate.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Interfaces.IMovementHandler
files.Summary: Strategy interface for implementing custom movement mechanics for animatronics. Allows seamless switching between instant teleportation, smooth transitions, or physical navigation grid routing.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Logger.PizzeriaArgs
files.Summary: Specialized zero-allocation arguments pooling container used to parse and format data inside without allocations.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Logger.PizzeriaLogger.OpenLog
files.Summary: Structural optimized token that processes data chaining streams directly inside shared layout buffers memory allocations.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Logger.PizzeriaLogger
files.Summary: Core Zero-Allocation, highly optimized, fluent-style logging engine for the framework. Uses caching and compile-time caller file paths to append structured metadata into Unity Console.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.AI.AnimatronicData
files.Summary: Serializable structural registry holding configuration assets, blueprints, and core model links for spawning a specific animatronic type.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.AI.AnimatronicManager
files.Summary: Central orchestration system responsible for managing runtime initialization, difficulty scaling, asynchronous spawning, and threat monitoring loops across all active scene animatronics.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.Audio.PizzeriaPhoneGuyManager
files.Summary: Dedicated audio manager responsible for orchestrating the Phone Guy playback pipeline. Handles asynchronous clip end tracking and custom UI mute state toggles without bloating the GameManager.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.GameLoop.CameraManager
files.Summary: Central management system that orchestrates camera switching logic pipelines, coordinates screen-space UI static noise overlay blends, and manages async execution token lifecycles.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.GameLoop.GameManager
files.Summary: Central gameplay master state controller orchestrating the main lifecycle timelines, clock intervals, structural energy usage calculation loops, and async engine token operations.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.GameLoop.TabletManager
files.Summary: Manages the operational cycle state of the monitoring tablet hardware, coordinates timing restrictions, synchronizes core energy usage modifiers, and dispatches UI state validation hooks.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.UI.CustomNightManager
files.Summary: Central manager for Custom Night UI screen inputs. Handles presets modifiers, runtime difficulty cloning, and serializing customized layouts into data matrices.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.UI.PizzeriaSettingsManager.SettingElement
files.Summary: Context data container defining dynamic parameter keys, graphical object bindings, defaults, and serialized callback dispatches.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.UI.PizzeriaSettingsManager.SettingType
files.Summary: Defines Supported UI input controllers types mapped inside configuration matrices.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Managers.UI.PizzeriaSettingsManager
files.Summary: Central manager component that handles global options, resolution loops, Unity quality matrix controls, mixer parameter interpolation, and settings serialization layers.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Player.PlayerHeadRotation
files.Summary: Manages the player's panoramic head rotation utilizing realistic inertia formulas based on mouse placement coordinates. Includes integrated asynchronous pipelines for scripted object gaze tracking and smooth dynamic camera field-of-view (FOV) transitions.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Player.PlayerInteraction
files.Summary: Handles player raycast detection targeting interfaces like and . Differentiates between click execution inputs and dragging behaviors using calculated screen-space pixel movement thresholds.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.SaveSystem.PizzeriaCrypto
files.Summary: Core cryptographic helper that generates obfuscated byte masks for stream encryption routines.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.SaveSystem.PizzeriaSaveManager
files.Summary: Universal, high-performance binary save system that supports all data types by caching raw byte blocks encrypted via dynamic 64-bit CPU register masks.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.ScriptableObjects.AnimatronicConfig
files.Summary: Data architecture asset holding configuration parameters, identity markers, and base time metrics for an animatronic character.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.ScriptableObjects.CharacterDifficultyData
files.Summary: Serializable data structure pairing an animatronic configuration asset directly with a specific runtime AI difficulty level.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.ScriptableObjects.NightProfile
files.Summary:
ScriptableObject profile managing shift durations, time speed parameters, and character difficulty arrays for a specific night configuration.

Example of use:

int currentAggression = currentProfile.GetAILevelForCharacter("Freddy");

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Structs.ActionsStruct
files.Summary: Represents a single action button inside a popup notification.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Structs.DecomposedTimeData
files.Summary: Serializable registry layout containing hours and minutes split into individual digits. Primarily used to handle mechanical split-flap or digital rolling animation clocks at night ends.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Structs.OnAiChangedEventStruct
files.Summary: Serializable structural pair linking a specific AI level index constraint to a native UnityEvent response hook.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Structs.PopupStruct
files.Summary: Configuration data for a single popup notification.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.UI.GameLoop.GameOverScreen
files.Summary: UI controller responsible for rendering the Game Over presentation layer. Dynamically injects the attacking animatronic's visual portrait sprite and localized tactical survival description.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.UI.GameLoop.NightSequence
files.Summary: UI manager responsible for driving the cinematic entry (Night Intro) and victory (6 AM) presentation screens. Decomposes dynamic time integers into separate digits to sync with structural mechanical clock flip animations.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.UI.GameLoop.PizzeriaPause
files.Summary: Component managing the core gameplay pause state. Automatically alters the global physics time scale and dispatches structural lifecycle events to toggle interface overlay canvases.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.UI.Menu.CustomNightCharacterSlot
files.Summary: UI controller slot governing interaction inputs, display text metrics, and conditional level change callbacks for a separate character configuration panel.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.UI.Menu.PizzeriaMenuPage
files.Summary: Component managing the state, lifecycle, and animation properties of an individual decoupled menu page panel. Works in tandem with via Animator Blend Trees.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.CameraCameraUtils
files.Summary: Utility component that dynamically creates screen-matched RenderTextures for security cameras. Implements real-time 3D visibility checks using viewport mapping and physical raycasting occlusion tests.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.DraggableWindow
files.Summary: UI utility component that implements the interface. Allows seamless, real-time mouse dragging of UI panels, popup nodes, or custom window forms across canvas zones.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.EventsUtils
files.Summary: Utility bridge component designed to expose simple scene-management methods to Unity lifecycle systems. Ideal for triggering level loads directly via Animation Events, UnityEvents, or Timeline track keyframes.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.PizzeriaPopupNotify
files.Summary: A persistent, queued popup notification system with animated transitions and dynamic buttons. Automatically initializes before the first scene loads and survives across scene changes.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.PizzeriaSceneLoader
files.Summary: Core non-blocking asynchronous scene manager. Handles runtime canvas generation, UI slider progression mapping, and automatic data saving serialization wrappers.

files.Title: PizzeriaFramework.Utils.SerializableType
files.Summary: A custom utility wrapper that enables native Unity serialization for standard C# System.Type properties. Implements to safely convert type data into assembly strings and back.
